space_name: Uniqueness methodology and R&F with hashing
topic: Historical unique recalculation scope and plan
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the required historical period for recalculating unique metrics. It was determined that data analysis for Latvia requires a start date of at least January 2021. Regarding the scope, it was suggested to limit the rollback of unique calculations only to 2022. The plan is to perform these unique fixes and checks across all countries on a staging environment before final implementation.
decisions: Latvia's unique data recalculation must start from January 2021.
The rollback of unique metrics should be limited to the year 2022.
All country fixes will initially be tested on a staging environment.
action_items: Implement unique metric fixes for all countries on stage and check results.
